---
title: "Popularity of the Name Eliza Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the baby names CSV and filter to girls named Eliza
eliza_data <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv") |>
  filter(name == "Eliza", sex == "F")

# Plot annual counts from 1880 to 2025
ggplot(eliza_data, aes(x = year, y = count)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named Eliza in the U.S. (1880–2025)",
    subtitle = "Annual count of female births recorded by the Social Security Administration",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
